overview.Module Title: Numerical Analysis Of Partial Differential Equations

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To provide an introduction to the main topics of Numerical Analysis with the central theme on the solution of linear algebraic equations and partial differential equations. To practice the use of AI in computer implementation of the numerical algorithms, and be able to check the correctness, analyse the efficiency and iterate.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Analyse the accuracy, efficiency and convergence properties of numerical methods for solving linear algebraic and differential equations. B. Construct numerical methods for solving linear systems of algebraic equations. C. Approximate solutions of eigenvalue problems for finite dimensional operators. D. Construct numerical methods for solving second order differential equations using finite differences. E. Implement numerical methods for solving linear algebraic and differential equations.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The delivery of the module consists of a series of lectures and lab sessions. Lectures cover the theory of numerical analysis, paying special attention to the development/construction of the different methods and their analysis. They also contain a wide range of examples showing how to address theoretical questions. The lab sessions are intended to provide students with the opportunity to write their own computer code to implement the different methods studied during the lectures. The use of AI is integrated to the labs through e.g. code generation, test examples generation, and AI Tutor. In particular, we will evaluate, test and verify all the contents generated by AI, which is eventually based on one's own understanding of computer code.
